### Decisions

Decisions are logged in PROJECT.md Key Decisions table.
Recent decisions affecting current work:

- [Milestone init]: Extend the existing Traffic Check app (brownfield); core `/api/traffic` route and `TrafficResponse` contract are frozen — new capabilities get sibling routes/contracts
- [Milestone init]: v1 ships TabAPI-only (no SerpAPI/`SERPAPI_KEY`); creatives are a client-side view of the advertisers payload, merged into Phase 3 per coarse granularity
- [Research]: Referring sites must be framed as link-based referring domains (Backlinks API), never visit-weighted referral traffic — labeling pinned in `PANEL_INFO` at Phase 2 planning
- [Phase 1]: Cache factory: stateless createCachedStore<T>() with factory-default TTL/capacity constants; tabapi.ts calls it bare (single home for 24h TTL / 100-entry values)
- [Phase 1]: Cache eviction stays FIFO-by-insertion (Map order), not LRU — zero-behavior-change phase; factory reproduces tabapi.ts get sequence step-for-step (prune-before-insert, strict expiresAt > now)
- [Phase 1]: Injectable now clock seam replaces baked-in Date.now() for TTL testability without fake timers
- [Phase 1]: Panel primitives extracted verbatim to src/components/panel.tsx; PANEL_INFO/SOURCE_LABELS stay consumer-owned (D-01/D-02)
- [Phase 08]: Per-slice cache isolation: four createCachedStore instances in seranking.ts (overview, keywords, competitors, backlinks) keyed domain / domain:source:limit - backlinks (100 credits) is never refetched by keyword requests — Backlinks are loaded on demand only (locked 2026-10-22); a separate route will call getSeRankingBacklinks, nothing auto-fetches it
- [Phase 08]: SE Ranking error contract fixed at lib boundary: invalid_api_key / insufficient_credits / rate_limited / seranking_error / network_error with Vietnamese messages; key only in the Authorization header, never in messages, cache keys or thrown data — Mirrors ads-transparency.ts failure() mapping; upstream error bodies are not passed through
- [Phase 08]: Phase 08: /api/seranking returns a per-slice {data|error} envelope via Promise.allSettled (LIST_LIMIT=10, source default 'us' validated /^[a-z]{2}$/, uppercase rejected) and never imports the backlinks client — the 100-credit backlinks/summary call lives only behind /api/seranking/backlinks
- [Phase 08]: Phase 08: backlinks upstream failure returns HTTP 200 with an error slice (mirrors the envelope contract); only invalid_domain (400) and missing_api_key (500) are HTTP errors, keeping the UI render path uniform
- [Phase 08]: Phase 08: route validation order domain -> source -> key so bad input never surfaces as a key-configuration error nor triggers an upstream call; errorResponse/toErrorSlice duplicated (~10 lines) across the two routes per plan sanction instead of a shared helper outside the plan file list
- [Phase 08]: Phase 08 plan 03: SerankingPanel fetch state keyed by requestedDomain and derived per render (domain change degrades view to loading/idle, stale responses unrenderable) - satisfies react-hooks/set-state-in-effect with zero effect-body setState
- [Phase 08]: Phase 08 plan 03: ad cards render untrusted advertiser strings as React text nodes only, landing <a> href typed to a validated http/https landingUrl string with rel=noopener noreferrer (T-08-11); backlinks button hidden after success and reset on domain change so the 100-credit call fires only on explicit clicks (T-08-14b)
- [Phase 08]: [Phase 08 plan 04]: Dashboard wiring is exactly two lines (SerankingPanel import + keyed render after AdsPanel in Results) - the section owns its own fetch lifecycle, so TrafficDashboard gains no state
- [Phase 08]: [Phase 08 plan 04]: No existing dashboard test needed modification for the extra /api/seranking fetch - all-urls traffic-fixture mocks drive SerankingPanel into its designed fallback-error path, which is the required degradation behavior
- [Phase 08]: [Phase 08 plan 04]: All four .env.example key values blanked to empty assignments (names, comments, TRAFFIC_MONTHS=3 kept) per user-confirmed 2026-10-22 hygiene decision; removed values never echoed; user must rotate the previously committed keys (they remain in git history)
